title: Register with the construction industry long service scheme
what: Register with the state's portable long service leave scheme and report eligible construction workers' service.

laws.title: Construction Industry Portable Paid Long Service Leave Act 1985

assessment.summary: Employers must register with the industry's portable long service leave scheme, report workers' service and pay a levy.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
Registration, quarterly service returns and the levy.
